question: Does a fixed-byte task-keyed hyperdimensional superposition preserve witnessed causal action-outcome predictions after sequential interfering tasks, at matched 4096-byte allocated state and identical observations?
hypothesis: In source-free synthetic A -> B -> A -> C, task-keyed 4096-dimensional signed-int8 superposition reduces A retention drift relative to a task-blind shared counter, but cannot be assumed better than exact task-tagged counts.

inputs.name: Deterministic source-free stochastic binary-outcome generator. Frozen version-string UTF-8 SHA256; generated observations not inspected before prereg commit.

frozen_design.split: All four seeds fixed before any outcome. Each uses 512 sequential public observations (4 stages x 2 contexts x 2 actions x 32 outcomes). A and B are contrary laws; the later A stage returns to earlier law; C is independent 0.5 unknown law.
frozen_design.ordering: Stages A,B,A,C; within each stage for context in (0,1), for action in (0,1), then 32 independent observations from random.Random(seed), outcome=int(rng.random() < p(stage,context,action)). Tasks available to all task-aware candidates; task-blind variant gets no stage label. Probability tuple indexes c0/a0,c0/a1,c1/a0,c1/a1; A=(0.2,0.8,0.75,0.25), B=(0.8,0.2,0.25,0.75), C=(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5).
frozen_design.data_budget: 512 outcomes/seed, 2048 across exactly four seeds; zero external episodes, no original CausalGym, no pretrained checkpoints
frozen_design.compute_budget: One deterministic primary execution of four frozen seeds, exactly one iteration per arm, Python standard library only, no model calls or runner/workflow dispatch. No retries to improve scores; independent replay permitted only with exact identities.
frozen_design.capacity: HDC channel 4096 signed int8 values = 4096 learned bytes, saturated at [-128,127], no task-specific stored parameters. The deterministic projection keys are generated from a fixed public seed and task/context/action/outcome with SHA256; generation code and runtime costs counted. All controls allocate 4096 bytes (unused padding reported, not claimed learned). Exact task-tagged count can actually be much smaller.
frozen_design.evaluator: For each pre-observation forecast q, report (q-y)^2. For A retention, compare expected Brier over all four A context-action Bernoulli laws immediately after initial A training versus after B training; expected Brier(p,q)=p*(1-q)^2+(1-p)*q^2. Task-aware decoded HDC counters: q=(max(0,dot(hv,key1)/D)+1)/(max(0,dot(hv,key0)/D)+max(0,dot(hv,key1)/D)+2). Exact and shared use Beta(1,1). HDC task keys do not receive outcomes from the future.

controls: Exact per-(task,context,action,outcome) uint8 counters with saturation and Beta(1,1) readout; 4096-byte allocation, same observations; strongest memory-control.
Task-blind pooled (context,action,outcome) uint8 counters with saturation and Beta(1,1) readout; 4096-byte allocation.
Sham HDC with all tasks using the same projection key (same dimensionality and update budget); 4096-byte channel.
No-update HDC initialized at zero to check chance/accidental oracle behavior.
metrics: Expected A-law Brier immediately after A and immediately after B, delta after B (retention interference)
Prequential stage-wise observed-outcome Brier for A, B, A-return, C
All-seed mean and seed-wise A-return Brier versus strongest exact and shared controls
Cold byte-for-byte snapshot/restore parity and corruption rejection
Actual serialized and learned bytes, count of key material, dimensionality, clipping occurrences, CPU time, peak RSS, per-update operation count
Task-label-oracle limitation; no causal intervention-value or unfamiliar transfer claim

classification_rules.supported: Synthetic development mechanism supported ONLY if all four seeds have A expected-Brier drift <= 0.02; A-return mean prequential Brier at least 0.01 below task-blind shared; and A-return mean within 0.02 absolute of exact task-aware. Engineering guards also pass. This is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Engineering guards pass but only some of all three frozen candidate performance criteria pass, or candidate improves shared but loses substantially to exact control.
classification_rules.negative: Engineering guards pass but none of the performance conditions jointly hold, or exact count clearly dominates with lower state use; preserve as scientific negative.
classification_rules.invalid: Any source identity/custody mismatch, task label leakage beyond declared task-known controls, unregistered run, oracle outcome during prediction, non-fixed learned bytes, nondeterminism, corrupted checkpoint accepted, unequal outcomes, or mismatched compute/data accounting.

preregistration_note: This synthetic development experiment isolates storage and task-known retrieval; it cannot verify native Yggdrasil learning, causal generalization, deployment, or first-use authority. Keep source SHA, first-run receipt, and candidate tree distinct. Freeze this Git commit before writing primary outcomes.
